name: gad_yelpchi
description: YelpChi review-fraud graph (23,831 nodes, 32 features, 1,217 anomalies).
notes: The largest graph in this family; real fraud labels rather than injected outliers. ada_gad and diffgad are deliberately absent from compatible_methods: each refuses to run on a dataset its authors shipped no tuned configuration for, and inventing one would publish a number from hyperparameters nobody chose. Stored as the upstream .mat rather than converted to a PyG .pt at fetch time: the conversion needs torch and torch_geometric, and the manager is a thin orchestration node that carries neither. The .mat methods read this file directly with no conversion at all; a method wanting PyG calls graflag_runner.read_mat inside its own container, where those libraries exist.
